segments.title: LoopDesk Â· Recycling Outreach CRM
segments.body: Independent portfolio prototype. All data is fictional. This local demo follows one enquiry from contact to report.

segments.title: 01 / Start with a clear overview
segments.body: Each browser gets an isolated 24-hour workspace. Open opportunities, recorded estimates and due follow-ups stay together.

segments.title: 02 / Keep organisations and people connected
segments.body: Search the contact book, edit details and archive records while retaining linked opportunity history.

segments.title: The right person, with the right organisation
segments.body: Fictional contacts use example-domain email addresses. The prototype never sends email.

segments.title: 03 / Turn an enquiry into an opportunity
segments.body: Link the organisation and contact. Add a service, owner, stage, optional AED estimate and a clear next action.

segments.title: 04 / Keep the next conversation on the calendar
segments.body: Dated follow-ups appear in due-today and overdue views. Activity notes retain the context.

segments.title: 05 / Move forward with a visible history
segments.body: The change from Qualified to Proposal is recorded transactionally. Stale edits are rejected with a reload message.

segments.title: 06 / Export exactly the current view
segments.body: Search and filters apply to both the board and CSV. Spreadsheet formula prefixes are neutralised during export.

segments.title: 07 / Finish with a report you can explain
segments.body: Open counts exclude Won and Lost. Overdue uses Dubai dates. Won amounts are recorded estimates, not recognised revenue.

segments.title: Local demonstration Â· Source and tests included
segments.body: Verified with automated and browser checks. PostgreSQL hosting and a public deployment remain pending; no company adoption is claimed.
